Build the Validation Folds of the Molecular Diagnostic Branch

Source: R/barcoding_validation.R
build_barcoding_folds.Rd

Step 5 of the branch. Reads the library written by finalize_barcoding_library(), builds the two partition schemes (E and G), checks the hard rule on every fold and writes the fold tables and their summary. The training set is not written: it is the rest of the library of the locus, and writing it would multiply the size of the tables without adding information.

Usage

build_barcoding_folds(
  library_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "4_library"),
  output_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "5_folds"),
  schemes = c("species", "genus")
)

Arguments

library_dir

Character. Output directory of finalize_barcoding_library().

output_dir

Character. Destination; refused inside a directory of the phylogeny.

schemes

Character vector. Schemes to build; defaults to both.

Value

Invisibly, a list with folds (by scheme) and summary. Writes TABLE_barcoding_folds_species.csv, TABLE_barcoding_folds_genus.csv and TABLE_barcoding_folds_summary.csv.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
build_barcoding_folds(
  library_dir = "11_barcoding/4_library",
  output_dir = "11_barcoding/5_folds"
)
} # }
